newsitem.title: USA: Indian foreign minister to visit Washington.
newsitem.headline: Indian foreign minister to visit Washington.

text.p: Indian Foreign Minister I.K. Gujral will visit Washington next month for talks with U.S. leaders, an Indian embassy spokesman said on Tuesday.
The spokesman said no date had yet been fixed for the trip, which reports in Delhi said would be around the middle of the month. U.S. State Department officials also said no date had been fixed.
Washington has been increasingly interested in building up economic relations with India as it opens its economy.

The United States has also been encouraging India and its neighbour Pakistan to join efforts to curb the spread of nuclear weapons. Both say they have no nuclear arms programmes but analysts say they could swiftly assemble a bomb.
